description: Equipment Fault Reporter turns the vague "describe the problem" box into a guided five-step fault report: equipment and asset tag, symptoms (with safety hazards and try-this-first tips), impact on trading, engineer access and contact, and a review that shows a calculated P1–P4 priority with the reasons and the response target. The whole report is saved in one text column, together with a readable summary for the engineer.
features: Symptom checklist with try-this-first self-help tips
Safety hazards with hotline, trading impact
Automatic P1-P4 priority with reasons and response target
Stores the whole report (with a readable summary) as JSON in one text column
